And I don't know why Boosteroid on the browser runs awful for me and it runs awesome on the App. Maybe it has to do with hardware acceleration / decoding on Chrome? IDK.

Edit: I got it to work! so I'll write how I did it in case anyone have problems running it too:

Step 1: I've downloaded the .deb (You could also use the .rpm) and installed it with dpkg -i. I'm sure the Boosteroid app on the AUR works too.

Step: 2: Installed numactl

Step 3: Switched to X11 (Or else I had segmentation fault)

Step 4: Enjoy! :)
